contacts.institution_name: Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland (RCSI)

contact.name: Marc Sturrock
contact.evidence_quote: International Offices are invited to get in touch if you are interested in joining our network or would like to learn more. Our academic lead and Erasmus Officer, Dr Marc Sturrock is responsible for initiating and implementing our inter-institutional agreements.

contacts.rung: Institutional Erasmus+ coordinator. Dr Marc Sturrock is responsible for initiating and implementing inter-institutional agreements and serves as the Erasmus Officer.

external_collaboration.evidence_quote: In Ireland, we work closely with a network of clinical partner sites, including Connolly Hospital, Beaumont Hospital, St James’s Hospital, the Rotunda Hospital, Mater Misericordiae University Hospital, Our Lady of Lourdes Hospital Drogheda, Cavan General Hospital and Bon Secours Hospital. These partnerships provide valuable clinical insights and opportunities to translate research into practice.
